headline: Set date for public hearings on the 37 Enon Street apartment project and a proposed moratorium on data center use.
summary: The board will consider a recommendation to accept part of Millbrook Road as a public way, review a subdivision plan for 23 Cressy Street, and adopt a Fiscal Year 2027 fee for affordable housing units. It will also set hearing dates for a 179-unit development at 37 Enon Street and a proposed zoning moratorium on data centers.
items: Recommendation to City Council for acceptance of a portion of Millbrook Road between 15 and 51 Millbrook Road as a public way
Subdivision Approval Not Required Plans for 23 Cressy Street – Louis J. Muggeo
Adopt Fiscal Year 2027 Fee in Lieu of Affordable Housing Units – Update Table 1 per Chapter 315 Inclusionary Housing Regulations

Set date for public hearing on Site Plan Review #171-26, Special Permit #207-26, and Inclusionary Housing Application #31-26 for 37 Enon Street – Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander & Femino: demolish existing supermarket and build 179 residential apartments (60% one-bedroom, 40% two-bedroom), with 22 units (12%) affordable at or below 60% AMI, about 2,600 square feet of retail space, and a special permit for 281 parking spaces instead of the required 367
Set date for public hearing on City Council Order #TBD – proposed zoning ordinance amendment to institute a temporary moratorium on data center use
location: City of Beverly Police Department Community Room, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly, MA 01915
